name: read_task_inputs
description: Read one to eight declared text/JSON fragments together, at most 32 KiB total. Use the same coordinates as read_task_input. Each returned fragment retains its own continuation; next_request identifies any requests not yet read. No implicit source or arbitrary local file access.

name: read_task_input
description: Read one declared frozen document. For JSON use pointer (empty string lists the root); large objects return keys, and strings resume with offset=next_offset. For text use inclusive start/end lines and column=next_column when continuing a long line. Every serialized result is at most 32 KiB. Follow has_more and the returned continuation coordinates; no arbitrary local files are accessible.

name: read_yui
description: Read declared Yui rules/templates; no tests, historical runs or personal files.

name: check_artifact
description: Check a JSON artifact against the explicit stage contract; this is not automatic mathematical certification.

name: submit_artifact
description: Submit a JSON artifact after its stage checks.

name: report_obstacle
description: Report an actual obstacle using these five direct fields. Countercheck the alleged implication against the complete definitions, quantifiers and inequality directions; a feasible example alone does not determine an extremum. A fact not yet proved or registered in the current draft is an obligation to complete, not by itself a gap. For a mathematical stop, identify the concrete implication and actual mathematical difficulty encountered during normal checking/completion, not merely unfilled inventory or exposition. No fixed time/attempt count or counterexample is required. SUBSTANTIVE_GAP/SUSPECTED_GAP stop for an actual supported mathematical obstruction; INPUT_CONFLICT stops for incompatible inputs. In NL0, use source retrieval and explicit conditional deferral for unavailable primary texts; MISSING_SOURCE_STATEMENT requires that no complete secondary statement can be obtained. Other stages may report SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE for an actual access obstacle. Ordinary unfinished work is not an obstacle report. No mathematical acceptance is generated.

name: check_draft
description: Preferred structured-object form of check_artifact: provide artifact as an actual JSON object, not an escaped JSON string. Same complete validation and acceptance scope.

name: submit_draft
description: Preferred structured-object form of submit_artifact: provide artifact as an actual JSON object, not an escaped JSON string. Same complete validation and acceptance scope.
